description: 2nd CE farmstead with evidence of a stone-walled octagonal structure interpreted as a possible shrine or temple. Site appears to have been almost totally abandoned in the early 3rd CE, but some evidence of early Anglo-Saxon re-use.
bibliography: Clay. “Archaeological Evaluation, Land off Horkstow Road, South Ferriby, North Lincolnshire,” 2004. https://doi.org/10.5284/1023709.

Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Land off Horkstow Road, South Ferriby, North Lincolnshire (Lincolnshire).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
